## Portfolio Overview

Product Design Lead with 10+ years in UX/UI and Product Design for B2B and B2C digital products used by millions. Experience includes leading design teams.

### Summary

Product Designer with 10+ years of experience across fintech, marketplaces, classifieds, healthtech, and leasing. I turn complex workflows and business requirements into clear, usable B2B and B2C products, from discovery to delivery. I combine hands-on product design and research with design leadership, DesignOps, and design systems expertise, developing teams and using AI-assisted workflows to connect user needs with business goals.

The visual portfolio is available at https://dmitryrybalka.com/. This overview is followed by the complete professional profile and case studies below.

### Current Positioning

- Role: Product Design Lead.
- Seniority: 10+ years in UX/UI and product design.
- Target role families: Lead Product Designer, Design Lead, Product Design Manager, Design Manager, UX Design Manager, Principal Product Designer, Staff Product Designer, and strong Senior Product Designer / Senior UX Product Designer roles.
- Adjacent fit: AI Product Designer, AI-assisted Product Designer, AI Design Workflow Lead, AI Design Systems Lead, and design-engineering bridge roles when product UX, design systems, prototyping, or AI workflows are central.
- Leadership scope: design teams, research setup, design systems, design process, mentoring, reviews, hiring support, and cross-functional alignment.
- Product domains: B2B SaaS, classifieds, marketplaces, fintech, trading, leasing, e-commerce, healthtech, SaaS, CRM, internal tools, analytics, and patient-facing digital care.
- Target contexts: AI-native or AI-enabled products where product UX, design systems, prototyping, or AI-assisted workflows are central.
- Platforms: web, mobile web, app, desktop, SaaS, marketplace, CRM, and internal tools.

### Professional Summary

Product Designer with 10+ years of experience across fintech, marketplaces, classifieds, healthtech, and leasing. I turn complex workflows and business requirements into clear, usable B2B and B2C products, from discovery to delivery. I combine hands-on product design and research with design leadership, DesignOps, and design systems expertise, developing teams and using AI-assisted workflows to connect user needs with business goals.
Experienced in leading full-cycle design from discovery and hypothesis framing to delivery, connecting user needs, business context, UX research, design systems, and product metrics such as conversion, retention, churn, NPS, and LTV.
Currently leading Product Design, UX Research, DesignOps, and Design Systems across an international classifieds group with 5M MAU and 8+ product verticals. Previously worked at Raiffeisen Bank and Raiffeisen Leasing on an institutional trading terminal, internal leasing platform, and B2B marketplace. At Yandex.Market, developed analytics products and seller-facing tools for marketplace teams and vendors. Strong in design reviews, team development, OKRs, cross-functional collaboration, and AI-assisted workflows.

## Positioning

### Short Positioning

Dmitry Rybalka is a Product Design Lead for complex B2B/B2C digital products, with 10+ years of experience across marketplaces, classifieds, fintech, healthtech, leasing, SaaS, CRM, analytics, and internal tools. He combines hands-on product design and research with design leadership, DesignOps, design systems, and AI-assisted workflows.

### Best-Fit Roles

- Lead Product Designer / Design Lead
- Product Design Manager / Design Manager / UX Design Manager
- Principal Product Designer
- Staff Product Designer
- Strong Senior Product Designer / Senior UX Product Designer / senior-grade Product Designer roles

Adjacent roles can also be a good fit when the product, scope, team, decision influence, and growth potential are strong:

- AI Product Designer / AI-assisted Product Designer
- AI Design Workflow Lead
- AI Design Systems Lead
- Design Engineer roles centered on design systems, product UX, prototyping, AI workflows, or design-engineering bridge work

Head of Design can be a fit mainly in smaller companies where the scope is manageable and remains close to hands-on product/design leadership.

Title alone should not be used as a strict filter. Broader Product Designer, UI/UX Designer, Product Designer (UI/UX), or senior IC titles can be relevant when the role has strong product scope, team quality, influence, and growth upside.

### Target Contexts

- Products with complex workflows, multiple user roles, and operational constraints.
- AI-native or AI-enabled products where product design, workflows, or design systems are central.
- B2B SaaS and workflow-heavy products.
- Marketplaces and classifieds with discovery, listing, search, checkout, logistics, or seller-side tooling.
- E-commerce products and seller/operator tools.
- Fintech and trading products where information density, precision, and trust matter.
- Enterprise/internal tools and analytics platforms.
- HealthTech products with clinic operations, patient flows, integrations, and regulatory complexity.
- Organizations that need stronger design quality, process maturity, research practice, and reusable systems.

### Differentiators

- Combines product design execution with design leadership and team maturity.
- Has experience leading designers and research while staying close to product details.
- Can establish design systems, design operations, and governance without losing practical product velocity.
- Has worked across consumer-scale and enterprise-scale products.
- Can translate ambiguous business and operational constraints into clear UX flows.
- Has experience introducing AI-assisted workflows for discovery, research synthesis, and documentation.
- Positioning emphasizes product impact, metrics, complex systems, leadership, discovery-to-delivery ownership, and business outcomes rather than pure visual/UI execution.

### Collaboration Style

- Cross-functional: works with product, engineering, analytics, business, marketing, sales, customer success, and operations.
- Structured: uses reviews, quality standards, OKRs, onboarding, and process visibility.
- Practical: focuses on workflows, measurable impact, reusable patterns, and product constraints.
- Mentoring-oriented: supports designers through reviews, 1:1s, onboarding, hiring support, and individual development plans.

### Domains

- Classifieds
- Marketplaces
- E-commerce
- FinTech
- Trading and investment products
- Leasing and CRM
- HealthTech SaaS
- Patient portals
- Internal tools
- Analytics dashboards

## Larixon Classifieds Case Study

### Overview

Larixon Classifieds is an international classifieds group with market-leading platforms across Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad & Tobago, and Jamaica, serving 5M monthly active users.

### Role And Context

- Role: Design Lead
- Dates: Aug. 2025 - Present
- Location: Cyprus
- Work format: Remote
- Scale: 5M MAU
- Platform: Web and app
- Product: Multi-country classifieds platforms
- Scope: Product Design, UX Research, DesignOps, Design Systems
- Team: 7 Product Designers, UX Research Lead, Product, Engineering, Marketing

### Contribution

- Led product design teams: Led 7 Product Designers and 1 UX Research Lead across 8+ product verticals.
- Launched UX Research from zero to one: Started cross-country research across Cyprus, Mongolia, and Tajikistan.
- Built Design System from zero to one: Created Web and App foundations with governance, DSO roles, and 90% component coverage for key flows.
- Implemented Figma Code Connect for the design system, reducing time-to-market.
- Introduced AI-assisted workflows: Supported discovery, research synthesis, and documentation.
- Established DesignOps: Introduced OKR-based reviews, Jira visibility, onboarding, IDPs, and quality standards.
- Improved team maturity: Introduced 1:1s, mentoring, onboarding, and IDPs to improve solution quality.

### Relevant Capabilities

- Design leadership
- UX research setup
- Design systems
- DesignOps
- AI-assisted product design workflows
- Multi-country product work
- Classifieds marketplace UX

## Raiffeisen Group Case Study

### Overview

Raiffeisen Bank is one of the top-10 banks in Russia and part of Raiffeisen Bank International Group. The work covered trading and investment products, including a professional terminal for institutional clients.

Raiffeisen Leasing is the group's corporate leasing business. The work covered B2B leasing products, including a marketplace, modular CRM, and internal tools for sales teams, dealers, and partners.

### Role And Context

- Role: Lead Product Designer
- Dates: Jul. 2021 - Aug. 2025
- Location: Moscow, Russia
- Work format: Hybrid
- Trading and investment period: Aug. 2024 - Aug. 2025
- Leasing marketplace and CRM period: Jul. 2021 - Aug. 2024
- Company reach: 2M+ retail clients at Raiffeisen Bank.
- Product audience: 500+ institutional clients using the trading terminal.
- Platforms: Web, desktop, internal tools
- Products: Trading Terminal, Leasing CRM
- Scope: Trading UX, Leasing UX, B2B Marketplace, CRM, FinTech UX
- Team: 5 Designers, Product, Engineering, Business, Sales, Operations

### Trading And Investment Products

- Led UX for a professional trading terminal: Designed a trading experience for 500+ institutional clients, including asset managers and brokers.
- Improved design quality across teams: Mentored 5 designers, ran design reviews and 1:1s, and supported hiring across 2 product teams.
- Defined product design strategy across 5+ tools: Aligned business goals, user needs, and product hypotheses across the investment product ecosystem.
- Introduced LLM-powered research workflows: Used LLM-powered tools to accelerate research preparation, synthesize insights, and explore early hypotheses.

### Leasing Marketplace And CRM

- Designed a B2B leasing marketplace and modular CRM: Created workflows for 19 role types, 350+ sales representatives, B2B clients, and car dealers.
- Increased process automation from 10% to 90%: Streamlined business rules, operational flows, and internal decision-making.
- Reduced offer generation time from 12 minutes to 2 minutes: Redesigned quoting workflows, UI logic, and offer preparation scenarios.
- Contributed to implementing the Triple Diamond design process for an organization of 40+ designers.

### Relevant Capabilities

- Fintech UX

- Enterprise workflows

- Design leadership and mentoring

## Medesk Ltd. Case Study

### Overview

Medesk is a B2B HealthTech SaaS platform for clinics and medical teams, used by healthcare providers across 35 countries. The work covered product UX, patient-facing flows, third-party integrations, and design system components for clinic operations and digital care.

### Role And Context

- Role: Senior Product Designer
- Dates: Sep. 2016 - Jun. 2019
- Location: Moscow, Russia
- Work format: Hybrid
- Scale: 1000 clinics, 35 countries
- Platforms: Web, SaaS, Patient Portal
- Products: Clinic Platform, Patient Flow, Design System
- Scope: HealthTech UX, B2B SaaS, Patient Flows, Design System, UI Components
- Team: Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support

### HealthTech SaaS And Design System

- Designed UX for a healthcare platform used by 1000 clinics: Improved core workflows for clinic teams, operations, and patient management across international markets.
- Designed and automated a design system using Storybook: Created Storybook-based UI components and scalable interface patterns for core product flows and third-party integrations.
- Launched an online treatment flow for 10K B2C patients and improved NPS from 37 to 54. Designed patient-facing experiences supporting digital treatment, communication, and care delivery; refined key product flows and patient interactions to improve service quality and user satisfaction.
- Integrated 10 third-party modules, the top 5 medical laboratories, and Storybook-based UI components. Designed integration flows supporting external services, lab data, and connected healthcare workflows.

### Relevant Capabilities

- HealthTech UX
- B2B SaaS
- Clinic operations
- Patient-facing flows
- Third-party integrations
- Design systems
- Storybook-based UI components

## FAQ

### Who is Dmitry Rybalka?

Dmitry Rybalka is a Product Design Lead with 10+ years of experience in product design, combining hands-on UX/UI work with design leadership, UX research, DesignOps, and design systems.

### What types of products has he worked on?

He has worked on classifieds, marketplaces, fintech products, trading terminals, leasing CRMs, e-commerce tools, analytics dashboards, healthtech SaaS platforms, patient portals, internal tools, and design systems.

### What is his current role?

He is currently Design Lead at Larixon Classifieds, an international classifieds group serving 5M monthly active users.

### What is his leadership experience?

He has led 7 Product Designers and a UX Research Lead at Larixon Classifieds, mentored 5 designers at Raiffeisen Group, supported hiring, ran design reviews, introduced 1:1s, improved onboarding, and created individual development plans.

### Does he have design system experience?

Yes. He has built design-system foundations at Larixon Classifieds with governance and DSO roles and implemented Figma Code Connect for the design system, reducing time-to-market. At Medesk Ltd., he designed and automated a design system using Storybook, with reusable UI components and scalable patterns.

### Does he have UX research experience?

Yes. He launched UX Research from zero to one at Larixon Classifieds and introduced cross-country research across Cyprus, Mongolia, and Tajikistan. He has also used LLM-powered tools for research preparation, insight synthesis, and early hypothesis exploration.

### What company reach, product audience, and measurable outcomes are shown in the portfolio?

Company reach: Larixon Classifieds serves 5M monthly active users (MAU). Product audience: seller tools for 35K vendors at Yandex.Market and a trading terminal for 500+ institutional clients at Raiffeisen Bank.

Reported outcomes include vendor onboarding time reduced from 90 days to 1 day at Yandex.Market; offer generation time reduced from 12 to 2 minutes and process automation increased from 10% to 90% at Raiffeisen Leasing; conversion increased from 0.5% to 1.6% at GdeMaterial; and NPS improved from 37 to 54 at Medesk Ltd.

### What roles would be a strong fit?

Relevant roles include Senior, Lead, Staff, and Principal Product Designer, as well as Design Lead and Product Design Manager, depending on the role’s scope. His expertise includes AI-assisted workflows, design systems, and prototyping. Head of Design roles may also be relevant when they combine hands-on product design with design leadership.

### What work formats and relocation options is he open to?

He is open to office, hybrid, and remote work, and to relocation.

### Where can the visual portfolio be viewed?

The visual portfolio is available at https://dmitryrybalka.com/.

### What is his English proficiency?

His English proficiency is B2 (Upper Intermediate).
